hypothesis: A safe geometric endpoint can remain in the nominal policy's stagnation basin. Admitting handoff only after the actual frozen GRU continuation predicts safe positive progress improves navigation beyond ordinary variable-duration policy rollout and fixed-prefix MPC.
difference: Evaluate the nominal policy itself, with its legal history and smoothing, after candidate prefixes; candidate adds a safe/productive re-entry constraint. No renewed deadline, side latch, trained recovery network or posterior.
novelty_status: UNVERIFIED. Policy rollout, safe policy switching and terminal admission are prior art; a meaningful incremental social-navigation capability must survive the same-budget ordinary-rollout comparison and closest-prior review. This is not automatically a paper method.

shared.humans: all current legal observable position/velocity/radius for safety, original nearest5 for value; no future tape or goals

planner.objective: same native reward plus frozen free-space terminal heuristic as progress-contract-v2

handoff.admission: predicted tail endpoint clearance >=0.2m at every step AND tail goal-distance decrease>=0.2m, or predicted goal reached
handoff.ranking: discounted original task return of prefix followed by GRU tail plus same terminal free-space heuristic
handoff.fallback: if all tails inadmissible, execute8 of original feasible MPPI plan; this is logged, not called certified
handoff.execution: revalidate stored prefix every actual step using current native safe mask and shared legal CV; invalidate to nominal if unavailable. Nominal handoff uses8-step reassessment cooldown, shared by rollout and candidate.

development.note: Previously observed native cases; not fresh. Existing240-root cohort used25s; this comparison uses native50s for every arm. No case picked from current outcome.

confirmation.conditional: only if development gate passes and credible prior-method difference remains

go: Against every comparator: no fewer successes and no more collisions or contacts; plus either >=2 extra successes OR >=5% lower paired both-success navigation time against strongest simple; actual admission changes choices; average decision<250ms. Otherwise KILL, no sweeps. Fresh outcome must preserve benefit with paired cluster interval excluding zero on its registered benefit metric.
repairs: At most one concrete implementation/representation repair, not a negative-outcome rescue.
resources: CPU planner and local3060 frozen GRU only. No4090; no training.
